address: Haarlemmerweg 201, Amsterdam-West (1901 brick house over a white rendered workshop ground floor, facing the Haarlemmervaart and the Westerpark; BAG pand 0363100012160400)
notes: Haarlemmerweg 201 (pand 0363100012160400, built 1901): a deep 10 m wide brick house of four storeys and two dormers, 15 m to the eaves, on the Haarlemmerweg facing the Haarlemmervaart and the Westerpark.

walls[0] the Haarlemmerweg front (panel 1, crops w01-359L 2021-03-22 and w01-359 2025-09-29, square on): a tall white rendered ground floor with two large round-arched glazed doors (hallDoors), three brick storeys of six segmental-arched white-framed windows, iron balconies on brick consoles in front of bays 1 and 4 of every upper storey.

NOT DRAWN (kit cannot say): the small round-arched windows over the side doors in bays 0 and 5 and the side doors themselves (hallDoors bays keep only a blank ground); the two pointed dormers with arched windows; the brick consoles under the balconies.
